repeatPin.method: fresh scratch copy of oc2 package.json+bun.lock in run/mg-<ts>/s10-pin; bun 1.4.4: bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun add @opencode/cli@2.1.4 --exact, bun install --frozen-lockfile; sha256 prefixes after each step
repeatPin.note: oc2 package.json also carries devDependency @types/bun "latest" (floating); it does not affect the OpenCode packages but a cut-over package.json should pin it or leave it out

platforms.method: npm view @opencode/cli@2.1.4 optionalDependencies; npm view each platform package os/cpu; compared with server/backends/opencode/runtime.ts:23-60 and the 1.18.35 entries in the worktree bun.lock
platforms.gap: No platform gap: every variant runtime.ts can pick exists in 2.1.4 (12 = the 1.18.35 matrix). The package NAMES change: runtime.ts:30,44 build unscoped opencode-<platform>; 2.1.4 ships scoped @opencode/cli-<platform> (bin/opencode inside, same layout). OPENCODE_CLI_VERSION (runtime.ts:5) and the dependency name opencode-ai -> @opencode/cli change too. The platform packages declare os+cpu but no libc, so bun installs glibc and musl variants side by side (4 x64 variants installed here), as with 1.18.35.
platforms.postinstall: @opencode/cli has scripts.postinstall node ./postinstall.mjs; Isomux resolves the platform binary directly, so the script is not needed
platforms.verdict: PASS-with-condition (rename the package prefix in runtime.ts)

advisories.method: bun audit --json in s10-pin (cli+client+plugin 2.1.4 + deps); npm audit --json on npm install --package-lock-only of the same three (285 deps); gh api /advisories?ecosystem=npm&affects=<pkg>
advisories.verdict: PASS (no advisory affects 2.1.4; every opencode-ai advisory has a fixed version, and 1.18.35 is outside both ranges)

selfUpdate.method: strace -f -e trace=connect,sendto,sendmmsg over mg-s10-net.ts: one 2.1.4 serve (common.ts env: OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1, config update:"disable"), one session + one mock turn, idle to 60 s. Run A with models fetch on, run B with OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH=1. No proxy.
selfUpdate.updateLogLines: grep -c "update check|updater|upgrade" = 0 in both server logs (control: "Sent HTTP response" = 3 each)
selfUpdate.sources: cli/src/services/updater.ts:534-540 (env gate); serve path (cli/src/commands/handlers/serve.ts, cli/src/server-process.ts) never references the updater; local probes: core/src/plugin/provider/vllm.ts:18, lmstudio.ts:27, ollama.ts:48
selfUpdate.instrumentControl: run A shows the external models.opencode.ai connect, so the observer sees outbound TLS

reinstall.method: mg-s10-reinstall.ts: profile at s10-reinstall/isomux-state/opencode/profiles/p1 (outside node_modules), 2.1.4 from s10-pin, one session+turn; find node_modules -newer stamp; sha256 of every profile file; mv node_modules aside; bun install --frozen-lockfile; re-hash; start again and list sessions
reinstall.profileFileHashes: 26 files, identical before and after reinstall (cmp)

productionPaths.profile: <AGENT_ROOT>/opencode/profiles/<16 hex> (server/backends/opencode/profile-paths.ts:23-35), e.g. ~/.isomux/opencode/profiles/<id>: data/opencode/opencode.db, log, snapshot; config, state, cache (plugin npm cache = cache/opencode/npm)

reinstall.caveat: start-server.ts does not set TMPDIR; 2.1.4 writes $TMPDIR/opencode and $TMPDIR/.bun-<uid>-*.so|.node (observed in the copy1 census), outside the profile and outside node_modules
